title: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt…
description: Gammu versions prior to 1.45.2 have a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the ReadWAPSettingsEntry() function. This flaw can be triggered by attackers supplying crafted backup files containing more than four TitleNN keys in the [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] sections. The vulnerability can cause heap memory corruption, leading to application crashes or potentially arbitrary code execution.
